E-COMMERCE CUSTOMER SUPPORT POLICIES

==============================================
RETURN POLICY
==============================================

1. Return Window:
   - Products can be returned within 30 days of delivery
   - Items must be in original condition with tags attached
   - Electronics must include all original accessories and packaging

2. Non-Returnable Items:
   - Personalized or customized products
   - Intimate apparel and hygiene products
   - Digital downloads and software
   - Perishable goods

3. Return Process:
   - Initiate return request through customer portal or support
   - Receive return authorization number
   - Ship item to designated return center
   - Refund processed within 7-10 business days after receipt

==============================================
REFUND POLICY
==============================================

1. Refund Timeline:
   - Standard refunds: 7-10 business days after item receipt
   - Original payment method will be credited
   - Store credit option available for instant refunds

2. Refund Amount:
   - Full product price refunded for eligible returns
   - Original shipping charges non-refundable
   - Return shipping costs borne by customer unless product defect

3. Partial Refunds:
   - Items showing signs of use: up to 50% refund
   - Missing accessories: prorated refund
   - Damaged packaging: 10-20% deduction

==============================================
CANCELLATION POLICY
==============================================

1. Order Cancellation:
   - Free cancellation before order ships
   - Cancellation available within 24 hours of order placement
   - No cancellation fee for orders in "Processing" status

2. Cancellation After Shipment:
   - Cannot cancel once shipped
   - Must follow return process after delivery
   - Refund subject to return policy terms

3. Cancellation Process:
   - Login to account and navigate to order history
   - Select "Cancel Order" option
   - Confirmation email sent within 1 hour
   - Refund initiated immediately for prepaid orders

==============================================
EXCHANGE POLICY
==============================================

1. Size/Color Exchange:
   - Free exchange for different size or color
   - Subject to availability
   - Exchange window: 30 days from delivery

2. Exchange Process:
   - Request exchange through customer support
   - Ship original item back
   - Replacement shipped upon receipt of original

==============================================
WARRANTY POLICY
==============================================

1. Manufacturer Warranty:
   - Electronics: 1-2 years manufacturer warranty
   - Warranty claims handled through manufacturer
   - Proof of purchase required

2. Extended Warranty:
   - Optional extended warranty available at checkout
   - Covers accidental damage and wear
   - Terms vary by product category

==============================================
SHIPPING POLICY
==============================================

1. Delivery Timeline:
   - Standard shipping: 5-7 business days
   - Express shipping: 2-3 business days
   - Same-day delivery available in select cities

2. Shipping Charges:
   - Free shipping on orders above ₹999
   - Standard shipping: ₹49
   - Express shipping: ₹149

3. Tracking:
   - Tracking number provided via email
   - Real-time tracking available on website
   - SMS updates for delivery status
